name: inttegro
description: Operate an Inttegro merchant account from OpenAI with live tools for commerce, contacts, files, reusable messages, confirmed actions, analytics, and portable MCP Apps views.

interface.longDescription: Understand orders, products, customers, files, balances, payouts, messages, and sales performance; create, preview, publish, archive, and send reusable SMS or email templates; take confirmed payment through masked choices and secure checkout; guide line-item refunds; manage commerce and file lifecycles; or turn SDK and checkout choices into an integration build and test plan.
defaultPrompt: Give me today's Inttegro brief and show the key trends.
Check order 1042 and show its latest status.
Create a buy link for a product and send it to a customer.
